scientific_integrity: Proof of both global-uniqueness statements is analytical; displayed dimensionless constants are quadrature approximations, not certified error enclosures.
scientific_limitations: Only undamped random acceleration with complete Poisson resetting of both state coordinates.
Two canonical experiments: nonzero crossing level from rest, and zero crossing level from nonzero reset velocity.
Counts continuous total crossings, not reset jumps, directional crossing rates, or first arrivals.
No claim of an independent audit or definitive publication priority.
title: Unique optimal resetting in two random-acceleration level-crossing experiments
